jobs.title: Software Engineer (Junior & Senior Tracks)
jobs.description: Andela connects African developers with global enterprises and scale-ups for fully remote engineering roles across North America, Europe, and beyond. Engineers work embedded in international product teams on full-stack, backend, data, and AI-adjacent projects. The talent network assesses hard and soft skills, English proficiency, and background before matching. Andela operates a fully remote permanent model across its entire organization, with historical roots in Lagos and Nairobi.
benefits: Access to upskilling, bootcamps, and the Andela talent network

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Flutterwave is one of Africa's largest payment infrastructure providers, serving businesses across the continent and in global markets. The Product Manager owns roadmap, discovery, and delivery for a core payments surface used by thousands of merchants. The role sits within Flutterwave's non-engineering product organization alongside commercial, risk, COO, and customer-experience functions. Candidates should have experience shipping fintech or platform products in high-growth environments.
benefits: Cross-border fintech experience across African and global markets

jobs.title: MIS Specialist
jobs.description: The MIS Specialist builds and maintains internal management information systems and reporting pipelines for finance and operations leadership at Flutterwave. Responsibilities include data consolidation across payment channels, dashboard development, and recurring performance reporting. The role is part of Flutterwave's non-engineering hiring track, which also includes commercial, risk, and COO functions. Strong analytical rigor and comfort with high-volume transactional data are essential.

jobs.title: Fraud Desk Analyst
jobs.description: Flutterwave's Fraud Desk Analyst monitors, investigates, and resolves fraud alerts across the company's pan-African payment network. Analysts triage real-time and batch alerts, document case outcomes, and feed learnings back into detection rules. The role sits within the Risk function, one of Flutterwave's actively hiring teams alongside Engineering and Commercial. Candidates should be comfortable working with transaction data under time pressure and communicating findings clearly.
benefits: Exposure to real-time fraud detection tooling

jobs.title: Business Development Lead, South Africa
jobs.description: Paystack, a Stripe company, is a leading African payments technology provider operating across Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Côte d'Ivoire, South Africa, and other markets. The Business Development Lead drives merchant acquisition and enterprise partnerships for the company's South Africa expansion. The role owns pipeline, deal cycles, and strategic accounts in a market where Paystack is actively scaling commercial presence. Candidates should have a track record of complex B2B deal-making in fintech or financial services.

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Analyst
jobs.description: The Senior Accounting Analyst supports month-end close, reconciliations, and management reporting for Paystack's Nigerian entity. Responsibilities include balance-sheet reconciliations, revenue recognition support, and coordination with external auditors. The role sits within Paystack's Business/Finance department, which is actively hiring alongside Engineering and Revenue functions. Candidates should have strong technical accounting fundamentals and comfort in a high-velocity fintech environment.
benefits: 20 days paid leave and sabbatical leave

jobs.title: Manager – Data Science, Advanced Analytics & AI
jobs.description: MTN Rwanda is the country's leading telecommunications and mobile-money operator, with MoMo powering a large share of digital financial activity. This permanent role leads the Data Science, Advanced Analytics & AI function within MTN Rwanda's Fintech division. Responsibilities include building predictive models, governing analytics platforms, and partnering with commercial and product leaders on data-driven decisions. The successful candidate will manage a growing team and set the AI/ML roadmap for MoMo and related services.
benefits: Permanent contract with MTN Group benefits

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst – Channel Performance
jobs.description: This permanent role analyses MoMo and digital channel performance for MTN Rwanda's Fintech division, delivering dashboards and actionable insights to commercial leadership. Responsibilities include KPI design, automated reporting, and deep-dive analysis of customer journeys across agent, app, and USSD channels. The Business Intelligence Analyst works closely with data science, product, and revenue teams. Candidates should be strong communicators who can translate data into clear commercial recommendations.

jobs.title: Specialist, Middleware Solutions & Operations Support
jobs.description: The Specialist supports and operates middleware and integration platforms that underpin MTN Rwanda's digital services, including mobile-money and enterprise APIs. Day-to-day work includes platform patching, capacity management, incident response, and collaboration with application and network teams. The role sits within MTN Rwanda's Information Technology department, one of the company's core hiring areas. Candidates should have hands-on experience with enterprise integration middleware and production support disciplines.

jobs.title: People Partner, Rwanda
jobs.location: Kigali (with travel to Muhanga and Kayonza)
jobs.description: Zipline is the world's largest autonomous delivery service, operating a nationwide drone logistics network in Rwanda since 2016, including Africa's first urban delivery network launched in 2026. The People Partner shapes people strategy, performance processes, and workforce planning across Zipline's Kigali, Muhanga, and Kayonza teams. Responsibilities include leadership coaching, organizational design input, and scalable people operations as the Rwanda operation scales. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Rwanda and be comfortable traveling frequently to distribution centers.
benefits: Regular travel across Rwanda distribution centers

jobs.title: Health Partnership Coordinator, Rwanda
jobs.description: Zipline delivers blood, vaccines, medications, and essential supplies on-demand to over 900 health facilities across Rwanda via autonomous drones. The Health Partnership Coordinator manages relationships with Rwanda's Ministry of Health, district health teams, and facility networks to ensure reliable service adoption and feedback loops. Responsibilities include partnership reporting, issue resolution, and coordination of rollout or expansion activities. The role requires comfort working across government, clinical, and operational stakeholders.
benefits: Collaboration with a global engineering and operations team

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, Rwanda
jobs.description: Zipline builds and operates the software that plans, dispatches, and monitors the world's largest autonomous logistics fleet, including its Rwanda nationwide network. The Senior Full Stack Software Engineer designs and ships features across the customer, operations, and fleet-facing stack, improving usability, scalability, and performance. Prior Rwanda-based cycles have sought strong React, Python, SQL, or Rust skills and experience with data and deployment pipelines. Candidates must be able to relocate to or already reside in Kigali.
benefits: Work on a world-scale autonomy and logistics stack

jobs.title: Principal Technical Officer – Application Development
jobs.description: Rwanda Revenue Authority recruits senior technical officers for its IT & Digital Transformation Department to support national tax-system modernization. The Principal Technical Officer – Application Development designs, builds, and maintains web applications and digital taxpayer services. Related circular positions cover e-payment and data validation, IT investigation, and web application performance tuning. RRA emphasizes integrity, professional excellence, and public-service impact in its recruitment.
benefits: Work on nationally significant digital systems

jobs.title: Youth Center Coordination Specialist
jobs.company: Ministry of Youth and Arts (MINIYOUTH), Rwanda Civil Service
jobs.description: The Ministry of Youth and Arts recruits through Rwanda's official civil-service e-recruitment portal (MIFOTRA) for specialist and coordination roles supporting national youth programs. The Youth Center Coordination Specialist supports planning, operations, and partnership-building for Rwanda's youth center network under an under-contract engagement. Rwanda's public-service portal regularly advertises positions across ministries, RDB, REB, and other agencies. Candidates should understand Rwanda's youth-development agenda and be comfortable working in a government reporting structure.

jobs.title: Senior Programme Manager – Rwanda
jobs.description: The African Management Institute (AMI) delivers management training and capacity building for entrepreneurs and MSMEs across Africa, with active Rwanda-based programs. The Senior Programme Manager leads planning, coordination, and delivery of a large-scale, multi-country enterprise-development program based in Kigali. Responsibilities include team leadership, partner and donor coordination, budget oversight, and quality assurance of program delivery. AMI also recruits MEL Specialists and Customer Growth roles in the same Kigali hub.
benefits: Direct impact on African MSME growth

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.location: Kigali (Head Office, Kigali International Airport area)
jobs.description: Bank of Africa Rwanda Plc is a leading commercial bank operating across Rwanda's retail and corporate banking market. The Financial Controller oversees financial reporting, internal controls, and regulatory submissions to the National Bank of Rwanda. Responsibilities include leading the finance team through month-end and year-end close, coordinating with external auditors, and advising senior management on financial performance. The role is based at the bank's head office in Kigali.

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program – University of Rwanda (Undergraduate, Cohort 5)
scholarships.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Rwanda provides fully funded undergraduate scholarships to academically talented students facing economic barriers, with a deliberate focus on women in STEM, refugees and displaced persons, and persons with disabilities. Applicants must first secure admission to an eligible first-year undergraduate program at the University of Rwanda, then apply through the dedicated MCFSP recruitment portal. The program is part of the Foundation's Young Africa Works strategy and includes mentorship, psychosocial support, and career-transition programming alongside financial aid.
scholarships.eligibility: Newly admitted first-year undergraduate applicants at the University of Rwanda; open to African students with particular focus on young women, refugees and displaced persons, and persons with disabilities; must meet UR admission requirements

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program – University of Rwanda (Master's, 3rd Cohort)
scholarships.description: The University of Rwanda, in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation, recruits approximately 30 fully funded master's scholars for eligible two-year graduate programs each academic year. The scholarship covers tuition and provides stipends, internship support, leadership development, and structured career-transition programming. Priority is given to academically qualified but economically disadvantaged young Africans, including those from conflict-affected and displaced backgrounds. Applicants must be newly admitted to an eligible UR master's program before applying to the scholarship.
scholarships.eligibility: Newly admitted master's students at the University of Rwanda; open to young Africans facing financial barriers; must meet program-specific admission requirements

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program – African Leadership University (ALU), Rwanda
scholarships.description: Launched in 2021, the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at ALU provides full scholarships to exceptional young Africans with strong academic, entrepreneurial, and leadership potential. Scholars study at ALU's Kigali campus (Kigali Innovation City) in mission-driven degree programs including Entrepreneurial Leadership, Software Engineering, and International Business and Trade. The program emphasizes problem-solving leadership and preparing graduates to tackle Africa's grand challenges across more than 50 African nationalities represented on campus.
scholarships.eligibility: Young Africans from 50+ countries demonstrating academic excellence, leadership potential, and financial need; must apply for ALU admission and scholarship consideration

scholarships.title: ALCHE Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program 2027
scholarships.provider: Mastercard Foundation / African Leadership College of Higher Education (ALCHE)
scholarships.description: The ALCHE Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program offers full-ride undergraduate scholarships to academically strong but financially needy young Africans with leadership potential. Benefits extend well beyond tuition to include living stipends, travel costs, accommodation, and a laptop, providing comprehensive support throughout the degree. ALCHE is part of the African Leadership University ecosystem, serving students from more than 50 African countries. The 2027 cohort application cycle is open for international applicants.
scholarships.eligibility: Students from 50+ African countries demonstrating financial need, academic excellence, and leadership potential; must apply for ALCHE admission

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program – University of Cambridge
scholarships.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Cambridge enables talented young Africans to pursue a master's degree at one of the world's leading universities while growing their leadership potential. The scholarship aims to cover everything students need to thrive in Cambridge, including full tuition costs and a monthly maintenance allowance. The application is built into the standard Cambridge postgraduate course application, with an additional scholarship statement; eligible African applicants receive an automatic application fee waiver. Decisions and program administration are managed jointly with the university.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding young Africans admitted to an eligible Cambridge master's course; must demonstrate leadership potential and a clear plan to contribute to Africa after study

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program – University of Cape Town (Postgraduate)
scholarships.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Cape Town has supported learners and students across Africa for over a decade, providing top-level education alongside leadership, career development, mentorship, and access to a global alumni network. Postgraduate applications (honours, master's, and eligible postgraduate diplomas in Health Sciences) remain open for the 2027 intake, while undergraduate applications for the same cycle have closed. Applicants should check faculty-specific requirements and deadlines before applying. The program is one of the Foundation's longest-running university partnerships.
scholarships.eligibility: African students applying to eligible UCT postgraduate programs (honours, master's, or select postgraduate diplomas); must meet faculty admission requirements

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship – Rwanda (2027/2028 cycle)
scholarships.description: Chevening is the UK Government's prestigious international scholarship programme, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, offering outstanding emerging leaders from more than 160 countries the opportunity to pursue one-year master's degrees in the United Kingdom. Rwanda is an eligible Chevening country, and the scholarship covers tuition, travel, and a monthly stipend. Applicants need at least two years of qualifying work experience, a strong academic background, and a commitment to return home to drive impact. Applications for the 2027/2028 cycle closed in early October 2026, with the next cycle expected to open around August 2027.
scholarships.eligibility: Rwandan citizens (and other eligible Chevening countries); at least 2 years work experience; return-home commitment; meet UK university and English language requirements

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Master's & PhD Scholarships 2027/2028
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC) / UK FCDO
scholarships.description: Commonwealth Master's and PhD Scholarships, led by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office through the CSC, fund citizens of Commonwealth developing countries—including most of Sub-Saharan Africa—to pursue postgraduate study in the United Kingdom. Awards cover full tuition, a monthly living allowance (approximately £1,712 outside London or £2,000 in London at current rates), return airfare, and additional study grants. Applications for the 2027/2028 cycle closed on 20 October 2026, with national nominating agencies submitting nominations by December 2026 and outcomes expected by July 2027. The next annual cycle typically opens in early September.
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth developing countries (including Rwanda and most of Sub-Saharan Africa); meet CSC academic and English language requirements; must meet return-home condition

scholarships.title: DAAD Scholarships (EPOS / Study Scholarships for Foreign Graduates)
scholarships.description: DAAD's EPOS (Development-Related Postgraduate Courses) and Study Scholarships for Foreign Graduates fund postgraduate study in Germany for graduates from developing countries, including all African nations, in development-related fields such as environmental governance, engineering, public policy, and related disciplines. Benefits typically include a monthly stipend of approximately €934, tuition support where applicable, travel allowances, and health insurance. DAAD runs these programs on a predictable annual schedule, with the main deadline for many lines falling in mid-October. Applicants usually need several years of professional experience relevant to the chosen program.
scholarships.eligibility: Graduates from developing countries including all African nations; typically requires relevant undergraduate degree and professional work experience; meet German university and language requirements

scholarships.title: Japan Africa Dream Scholarship (JADS) Program 2027
scholarships.provider: African Development Bank (AfDB) & Government of Japan
scholarships.description: The Japan Africa Dream Scholarship (JADS) is a capacity-building program jointly run by the African Development Bank and the Government of Japan, offering high-achieving African students a two-year fully funded master's opportunity in energy, agriculture, and related development disciplines at Japanese partner universities such as Hiroshima University, Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU), and Sophia University. The scholarship covers tuition fees, monthly living expenses, and travel costs, and includes a mandatory preparatory period. It is open to nationals of AfDB regional member countries who are 35 years old or younger and have a track record of supporting their country's development. Applicants must first apply and be admitted to a participating university before being considered for JADS nomination.
scholarships.eligibility: Nationals of AfDB regional member countries (all African states); 35 years old or younger; admitted to a participating Japanese university graduate program in energy, agriculture, or related fields

scholarships.title: ALX Africa Tech Programmes (Mastercard Foundation-funded tracks)
scholarships.provider: ALX Africa (African Leadership Group) / Mastercard Foundation
scholarships.description: ALX Africa delivers intensive, career-outcome-focused technology training across AI & Data, Creative, and Entrepreneurship tracks, with fully funded Mastercard Foundation-supported seats for eligible African learners. Programmes include Software Engineering, Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, Graphic Design, Content Creation, Virtual Assistant, and AI Career Essentials. From 2027, ALX is moving to a cohort-based learning model to strengthen outcomes, and learners can access both virtual and physical hub experiences across Africa. Mastercard Foundation-funded tech scholarship seats have a program value of approximately USD $5,000–$39,000 depending on track.
scholarships.eligibility: African origin or residing in Africa; 18 years of age or older; access to a computer and stable internet connection; financial need and leadership potential for MCF-funded seats
benefits: Access to ALX hubs and network

scholarships.title: ALU Mandela Scholarships (Rwanda Campus)
scholarships.description: The Mandela Scholarships at ALU's Rwanda campus are merit-based awards recognizing students who combine academic excellence with initiative, leadership, and purpose, rooted in Nelson Mandela's values. On the Rwanda campus, scholarships provide USD $3,000 per year toward BSc in Entrepreneurial Leadership (BEL) and BSc in Software Engineering (BSCE), and USD $4,000 per year for International Business and Trade (IBT). Related Mandela Scholarship tracks offer 100% tuition-only coverage for select candidates, including UWC-linked applicants and those pursuing conservation-focused pathways. The award is designed for students already demonstrating leadership who want to go further.
scholarships.eligibility: Prospective and current ALU Rwanda students demonstrating academic merit, leadership, and purpose; some tracks available to UWC graduates and conservation-focused candidates
